# ACAV LLC

ACAV LLC is an AV labor staffing company based in Phoenix, Arizona. ACAV provides AV labor staffing — stagehands, loaders, breakout techs, LED and lead operators — for corporate events, concerts and conventions.

## Contact

ACAV LLC
4237 N 11th St
Phoenix, AZ 85014
Phone: 480-330-0543
Email: info@phoenixavstaffing.com
Website: https://phoenixavstaffing.com/

## Service area

Phoenix metro / valleywide.

## What we do

AV labor staffing: stagehands, loaders, breakout techs, LED and lead operators.

## Labor tiers

- Tier 1 Basic Support Labor: stagehands, riggers, staging grips, scenic labor, loaders, utility technicians, floats, set technicians and strike technicians.
- Tier 2 Skilled AV Technicians: audio technicians, video technicians, lighting technicians, LED programmers, video engineers, GFX operators, show control, camera operators and breakout technicians.
- Tier 3 Lead Operators: audio, video and lighting operators, FOH engineers, technical directors, stage managers, production assistants and AV design.
